tip.label: Pet care tip
tip.imageIdea: A grooming-in-action photo, or a clean text graphic with the tip on-brand.
captions: 🐾 Grooming tip: Brushing your dog a few times a week between grooms cuts down on matting and shedding — and keeps them comfy. Need a hand? We come to you. 🚐
Did you know? Regular grooming isn't just about looks — it helps catch skin issues, lumps, and ear infections early. 🩺🐶 Book a mobile groom and we'll keep an eye out.
Wednesday wisdom 🐾 Overgrown nails can actually hurt your dog's posture and joints. We trim them right at your door — quick and stress-free.
Hot weather tip ☀️🐕 Never shave a double-coated breed all the way down — their coat helps regulate temperature. Ask us what's best for your pup's coat!
